Danielle Cruz: HelixCloud sent invoice HC-2042 for $3,420 but the PDF has no PO number; they say services terminated if unpaid in 10 days.
Omar Khan: Can you paste invoice id and vendor ref?
Danielle Cruz: Invoice HC-2042, vendor ref HXC-77. Charges: burst GPU minutes and snapshot storage.
Priya Sinha: Coupa auto-match failed. Looks like it should map to PO-9012 (Platform infra) but vendor omitted it.
APBot: ALERT: Invoice HC-2042 flagged - NO_PO_MATCH. Status: PAYMENT_HOLD. AP ticket AP-55111 created.
Nate Brooks: If vendor can reissue with PO-9012 that's easiest. If not, we'll need a one-time override with cost owner + FP&A signoff.
Danielle Cruz: Vendor offered to accept wire if ACH fails; they prefer not to suspend service.
Priya Sinha: Adding approvers: Nate (Eng owner) and Omar (FP&A). Approve within 48h to avoid suspension.
Omar Khan: Reviewed cash plan; can approve override. Add note "vendor billed missing PO; reissue requested".
APBot: Approvals recorded. PAYMENT_HOLD cleared. Payment scheduled on 2026-05-12 run. Please follow up with vendor to reissue future invoices with PO-9012.
Danielle Cruz: I'll notify HelixCloud and request corrected invoice template. Priya, close AP-55111 after payment posts.
